column1: # lStewieAl's Tweaks' settings (nvse_stewie_tweaks.ini): every key its code reads (settings.h HandleIniFile,
# Tweaks 10.05 source; 1,499 keys, measure/stewie/scripts/settings.tsv), with Tweaks' code default and
# VNV's value (Viva New Vegas' "VNV INI", ModdingLinked, MIT: NOTICE). Columns: section, key, code default,
# VNV's value. A code default written as an expression in Tweaks' source is kept as written after a
# ?, to be settled when the row reading it is built; floats are written without their F suffix. VNV's
# value '-' means VNV's INI has no such key (the code default stands); an empty value is VNV's empty text.
# The VNV column is read from VNV's INI with SimpleIni's rules (crates/stewie/src/ini.rs).
